code:
Notepad compile: 'initialize
	super initialize.
	text := ''''' classified: 'initialization'.
Notepad compile: 'initializeText: aString
	super initialize.
	text := aString' classified: 'initialization'.
Notepad compile: 'text
	^ text' classified: 'accessing'.
Notepad compile: 'text: aString
	text := aString' classified: 'accessing'.
Notepad compile: 'file
	^ file' classified: 'accessing'.
Notepad compile: 'file: aFileReference
	file := aFileReference' classified: 'accessing'.
Notepad compile: 'saveTo: aFileReference
	aFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :stream | stream nextPutAll: text ].
	file := aFileReference.
	^ aFileReference' classified: 'saving'.
Notepad compile: 'save
	file ifNil: [ self error: ''No file set: use saveTo: first'' ].
	^ self saveTo: file' classified: 'saving'.
Notepad compile: 'openView
	"Open a wrapped Rubric editor on the text. Ctrl+S (accept) updates
	the model and, when a file is set, saves to it."
	| window morph |
	morph := RubScrolledTextMorph new.
	morph beWrapped.
	morph setText: text.
	morph textArea announcer
		when: RubTextAccepted
		do: [ :ann |
			text := morph text.
			file ifNotNil: [ self save ] ].
	window := SystemWindow new.
	window setLabel: ''Notepad'', (file ifNotNil: [ '' - '', file basename ] ifNil: [ '''' ]).
	window addMorph: morph frame: (0 @ 0 corner: 1 @ 1).
	window extent: 500 @ 400.
	window openInWorld.
	window position: 60 @ 60.
	^ window' classified: 'views'.
Notepad class compile: 'on: aString
	^ self new initializeText: aString' classified: 'instance creation'.
Notepad class compile: 'open
	^ self new openView' classified: 'views'.
